events.name: Poetry Slam
desc: The English poetry slam competition will comprise of 3 rounds.
Poetry should contain the mentioned literary device at least once but is not restricted to it.
The poem will be judged based on creativity, idea, thought process and development, style and structure of writing, knowledge and usage of literary devices, and overall representation.
rules: The English poetry slam competition will comprise of 3 rounds.
Round 1: The online Elimination round: Contestants submit entries online; best are chosen.
Round 2: Impromptu Poetry writing and recitation round: Given a phrase with a literary device, write an original piece impromptu in 30 mins.
Final Round: Recite any original work you feel best represents you.
Content shouldn't be explicit or vulgar.
Judging criteria: creativity, structure, literary device usage, overall representation.

events.name: Spell-bee
desc: A 2 round team event with a maximum of 2 members per team.
rules: It would be a 2 round event.
It would be a team event with a maximum of 2 members a team.
Events would be conducted for the English language only.
Panel will pronounce words with some star marked words as tie-breakers.
Participants write spellings on a sheet of paper.
Specific teams qualify for Final based on previous round evaluation.
Teams press buzzer; order of buzzing determines word to spell immediately.
Team with most correct answers wins.

rules: Two-round event with eliminations.
Written Round: Quiz on TV series: Friends, Big Bang Theory, Sherlock, etc.

events.name: Pariksha pe Charcha
desc: EMPOWER THE FUTURE: LEAD, CREATE AND INSPIRE.
rules: A Hindi-exclusive event focused on cultural immersion and linguistic celebration. Thought-provoking topics will be given to teams of 5–6 participants.
Discussion format: teams get 30 seconds to think after the topic is given.
Each participant gets one minute to express their views.
Teams get 1.5–2 minutes at the end to share relevant facts or additional insights related to the topic.
Two minutes are designated for summarizing the discussion.
